root_causes.name: Schema DDL change outside the approved migration window
root_causes.description: A CREATE/ALTER landed out-of-window or from a non-deploy principal (MITRE T1505/T1195.002). Needs the dbx_ddl_audit feed.
root_causes.resolution: Enable DDL audit (event trigger / pgAudit), enforce a change window, and review any out-of-window DDL.

expected.description: Schema DDL change outside the approved migration window

root_causes.name: Hidden trigger created by a non-deploy principal
root_causes.description: A trigger whose backing function owner is off the deploy allow-list, firing on ordinary writes (T1546/T1505.001).
root_causes.resolution: Review the trigger and its function; drop if unauthorised; restrict trigger creation to the deploy role.

expected.description: Hidden trigger created by a non-deploy principal

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, c.relname AS table_name, t.tgname AS trigger_name, p.proname AS function_name, r.rolname AS owner FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid = t.tgfoid JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND r.rolname NOT IN ('postgres','ci_deploy','migrator') ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname

root_causes.name: Backdoored stored procedure/function by a non-deploy principal
root_causes.description: A routine authored outside change control by an off-allow-list owner (T1505.001).
root_causes.resolution: Review the routine body and provenance; drop if unauthorised; lock routine creation to the deploy role.

expected.description: Backdoored stored procedure/function by a non-deploy principal

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS routine, r.rolname AS owner, l.lanname AS language FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid = p.prolang WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND r.rolname NOT IN ('postgres','ci_deploy','migrator') ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname

root_causes.name: Untrusted procedural language or dangerous extension installed
root_causes.description: plpythonu/plperlu/plpython3u/plsh, or dblink/http/file_fdw installed — host-code-execution surface (T1505; CIS).
root_causes.resolution: Remove the untrusted language/extension if not required; restrict who can CREATE EXTENSION.

expected.description: Untrusted procedural language or dangerous extension installed

detect.postgresql: SELECT 'language' AS kind, lanname AS name FROM pg_language WHERE lanname IN ('plpythonu','plperlu','plpython3u','plsh') OR (lanispl AND NOT lanpltrusted) UNION ALL SELECT 'extension', extname FROM pg_extension WHERE extname IN ('dblink','http','file_fdw','plsh','plpythonu','plperlu','plpython3u')

root_causes.name: Routine body references outbound network egress
root_causes.description: Routine references dblink/http/UTL_HTTP/UTL_TCP/UTL_SMTP — outbound channel (T1041/T1505.001).
root_causes.resolution: Confirm whether the egress is a sanctioned integration; otherwise treat as a backdoor and remove.

expected.description: Routine body references outbound network egress

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS routine, r.rolname AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND p.prosrc ~* '(dblink|http_get|http_post|utl_http|utl_tcp|utl_smtp|pg_background)' ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname

root_causes.name: Routine body references OS command execution
root_causes.description: Routine references xp_cmdshell/sp_OACreate/COPY ... PROGRAM/os.system/DBMS_SCHEDULER (T1059/T1505.001).
root_causes.resolution: Treat as host-command capability; review and remove; restrict COPY PROGRAM and untrusted PLs.

expected.description: Routine body references OS command execution

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS routine, r.rolname AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND p.prosrc ~* '(xp_cmdshell|sp_oacreate|copy[^;]*program|os\.system|subprocess|dbms_scheduler)' ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname

root_causes.name: Time-bombed / logic-bomb routine
root_causes.description: A destructive action (DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE) gated on a date/time comparison (T1485/T1546).
root_causes.resolution: Inspect the routine; confirm it is not a sanctioned cleanup job; remove the time-gated destruction.

expected.description: Time-bombed / logic-bomb routine

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS routine, r.rolname AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND p.prosrc ~* '(drop\s+table|truncate|delete\s+from)' AND p.prosrc ~* '(current_date|current_timestamp|now\(\)|clock_timestamp|to_date|extract)' ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname

root_causes.name: SECURITY DEFINER routine owned by a superuser
root_causes.description: A definer-rights routine owned by a superuser — a standing privilege-escalation primitive (T1548).
root_causes.resolution: Re-own to a least-privilege role, pin search_path, and review the body; revoke EXECUTE from PUBLIC.

expected.description: SECURITY DEFINER routine owned by a superuser

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS routine, r.rolname AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner WHERE p.prosecdef AND r.rolsuper AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname

root_causes.name: Event / DDL / logon trigger installed for persistence
root_causes.description: An event trigger that fires on every login or DDL event — a persistence foothold (T1546).
root_causes.resolution: Review each event trigger and its function; drop unauthorised ones; restrict event-trigger creation.

expected.description: Event / DDL / logon trigger installed for persistence

detect.postgresql: SELECT e.evtname AS event_trigger, e.evtevent AS event, r.rolname AS owner, e.evtenabled AS enabled FROM pg_event_trigger e JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = e.evtowner ORDER BY e.evtname

root_causes.name: Malicious migration performing non-schema actions from CI/CD
root_causes.description: A migration that creates roles, GRANTs, or alters config (T1195.002). Needs the dbx_ddl_audit feed.
root_causes.resolution: Audit CI/CD migrations for role/grant/config statements; require review for non-schema DDL.

expected.description: Malicious migration performing non-schema actions from CI/CD

root_causes.name: Untrusted compiled extension, CLR assembly, Java, or UDF
root_causes.description: Native/compiled code loaded into the engine — C function (PostgreSQL), UNSAFE CLR, Oracle Java, mysql.func (T1554/T1505).
root_causes.resolution: Verify provenance of compiled code; remove untrusted C functions; restrict who can create them.

expected.description: Untrusted compiled extension, CLR assembly, Java, or UDF

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS routine, r.rolname AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid = p.prolang JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner WHERE l.lanname = 'c' AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname

root_causes.name: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES auto-grant persistence
root_causes.description: A standing default-ACL rule that re-grants on every future object (T1098). PostgreSQL-specific.
root_causes.resolution: Review pg_default_acl rules; revoke any that auto-grant to non-deploy principals.

expected.description: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES auto-grant persistence

detect.postgresql: SELECT COALESCE(n.nspname,'(global)') AS schema, d.defaclobjtype AS object_type, pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) AS grantor, d.defaclacl::text AS acl FROM pg_default_acl d LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = d.defaclnamespace

root_causes.name: Trigger or routine planted on an authentication / system object
root_causes.description: Positioned to harvest credentials or re-grant access (T1546/T1556). Vendor-specific (system-object triggers).
root_causes.resolution: Identify triggers/routines on auth/system objects; remove; lock down system schema.

expected.description: Trigger or routine planted on an authentication / system object

root_causes.name: Trusted routine tampered while preserving its signature
root_causes.description: Body-hash drift from baseline with identity unchanged — the supply-chain replace (T1554). Needs dbx_routine_baseline.
root_causes.resolution: Diff routine bodies against the reviewed baseline; restore from source control; investigate the change.

expected.description: Trusted routine tampered while preserving its signature

root_causes.name: Poisoned DB-driver / package
root_causes.description: An unexpected client running privileged DDL on first connection — DB-side fingerprint of a trojanized driver (T1195.001). Behavioral.
root_causes.resolution: Correlate first-connection privileged DDL with client/app fingerprints; pin trusted driver versions.

expected.description: Poisoned DB-driver / package

root_causes.name: Backdoor superuser role or login created
root_causes.description: A privileged principal off the administrative allow-list — rolsuper/rolcreaterole/rolbypassrls (T1136/T1098).
root_causes.resolution: Verify each privileged role against the admin allow-list; drop/disable unauthorised ones.

expected.description: Backdoor superuser role or login created

detect.postgresql: SELECT rolname, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolbypassrls, rolcanlogin FROM pg_roles WHERE (rolsuper OR rolcreaterole OR rolbypassrls) AND rolname NOT IN ('postgres','ci_deploy','migrator') ORDER BY rolname

root_causes.name: Migration-window evasion via object-inventory drift
root_causes.description: Reconciles live catalog vs deploy baseline to catch create-and-drop / back-dated objects. Needs dbx_object_baseline.
root_causes.resolution: Maintain an object-inventory baseline; investigate any drift not tied to an approved migration.

expected.description: Migration-window evasion via object-inventory drift

root_causes.name: Owner-spoofing — backdoor authored as the deploy role
root_causes.description: Scans routine bodies for backdoor signatures regardless of owner (closes the SCP-002/003 owner-check evasion).
root_causes.resolution: Body-signature match ignores owner; review every hit even if owned by the deploy role.

expected.description: Owner-spoofing — backdoor authored as the deploy role

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS routine, r.rolname AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND p.prosrc ~* '(xp_cmdshell|copy[^;]*program|dblink|alter\s+role|create\s+role|grant\s+)' ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname

root_causes.name: Extension-install evasion via trust-flag flip or disabled audit
root_causes.description: An untrusted PL re-flagged lanpltrusted=true, or a DDL-audit event trigger left disabled.
root_causes.resolution: Reset the language trust flag; re-enable the disabled DDL-audit event trigger; investigate who changed it.

expected.description: Extension-install evasion via trust-flag flip or disabled audit

detect.postgresql: SELECT 'trusted_flag_flip' AS issue, lanname AS detail FROM pg_language WHERE lanname IN ('plpythonu','plperlu','plpython3u','plsh') AND lanpltrusted UNION ALL SELECT 'disabled_event_trigger', evtname FROM pg_event_trigger WHERE evtenabled = 'D'

root_causes.name: Egress evasion via indirection (FDW / dblink / nested call)
root_causes.description: Network reach laundered through a foreign-data-wrapper or database link rather than a direct http call (T1041).
root_causes.resolution: Inventory foreign servers/wrappers; confirm each endpoint is sanctioned; drop unknown ones.

expected.description: Egress evasion via indirection (FDW / dblink / nested call)

detect.postgresql: SELECT s.srvname AS foreign_server, w.fdwname AS wrapper, pg_get_userbyid(s.srvowner) AS owner FROM pg_foreign_server s JOIN pg_foreign_data_wrapper w ON w.oid = s.srvfdw ORDER BY s.srvname

root_causes.name: xp_cmdshell via wrapper or transient re-enable
root_causes.description: SQL Server module bodies invoking xp_cmdshell under a non-xp_/sp_ wrapper name. SQL Server-specific.
root_causes.resolution: Scan SQL Server module definitions for wrapped xp_cmdshell; disable the feature; remove wrappers.

expected.description: xp_cmdshell via wrapper or transient re-enable

detect.sqlserver: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.sql_modules m JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id = m.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id WHERE m.definition LIKE '%xp_cmdshell%' AND o.is_ms_shipped = 0 AND o.name NOT LIKE 'xp[_]%' AND o.name NOT LIKE 'sp[_]%'

root_causes.name: Obfuscated logic-bomb — trigger date from a config table
root_causes.description: Select-then-destroy where the detonation condition is read from a config table or computed at runtime (closes SCP-007 literal-date gap).
root_causes.resolution: Trace runtime-computed destruction conditions; review routines that read a value then DROP/DELETE.

expected.description: Obfuscated logic-bomb — trigger date from a config table

root_causes.name: Encrypted or wrapped routine body
root_causes.description: Routine created WITH ENCRYPTION (SQL Server) or wrapped PL/SQL (Oracle) defeats all body scans. Concealment is the finding (T1027). Vendor-specific.
root_causes.resolution: On application routines, treat deliberate concealment as suspicious; obtain and review the source.

expected.description: Encrypted or wrapped routine body

detect.sqlserver: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.sql_modules m ON m.object_id = o.object_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped = 0 AND o.type IN ('P','FN','TF','IF','V','TR') AND m.object_id IS NULL
detect.oracle: SELECT owner, name, type FROM dba_source WHERE line = 1 AND UPPER(text) LIKE '%WRAPPED%' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','SYSAUX')

root_causes.name: Obfuscated dynamic-execution payload
root_causes.description: A routine assembling its statement at runtime via decode(base64)/convert_from/chr()/translate()/|| into EXECUTE (T1027/T1140).
root_causes.resolution: Review routines combining EXECUTE with decode/convert_from/chr/translate; de-obfuscate and assess.

expected.description: Obfuscated dynamic-execution payload

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS routine, r.rolname AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND p.prosrc ~* 'execute' AND p.prosrc ~* '(decode\(|convert_from|chr\(|translate\(|encode\()' ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname

root_causes.name: SECURITY DEFINER without a pinned search_path
root_causes.description: A definer-rights routine with no search_path pinned — hijackable by any caller regardless of owner (T1548).
root_causes.resolution: Pin a safe search_path on every SECURITY DEFINER routine; revoke EXECUTE from PUBLIC where possible.

expected.description: SECURITY DEFINER without a pinned search_path

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, p.proname AS routine, r.rolname AS owner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = p.proowner WHERE p.prosecdef AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND (p.proconfig IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p.proconfig) c WHERE c ILIKE 'search_path=%')) ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname

root_causes.name: Privilege backdoor via role membership
root_causes.description: A principal made a member of pg_read_all_data / pg_execute_server_program / rds_superuser etc. — no rolsuper flag, so SCP-016 misses it (T1098).
root_causes.resolution: Review membership in powerful default roles; revoke from principals that don't need it.

expected.description: Privilege backdoor via role membership

detect.postgresql: SELECT m.rolname AS member, gr.rolname AS granted_role FROM pg_auth_members am JOIN pg_roles m ON m.oid = am.member JOIN pg_roles gr ON gr.oid = am.roleid WHERE gr.rolname IN ('pg_read_all_data','pg_write_all_data','pg_execute_server_program','pg_read_server_files','pg_write_server_files','rds_superuser') ORDER BY gr.rolname, m.rolname

root_causes.name: Connection-time persistence via preload libraries / GUCs
root_causes.description: A malicious *_preload_libraries setting loads attacker code on every connection — no object to find (T1546/T1574).
root_causes.resolution: Review preload-library settings; remove unknown libraries; restrict ALTER SYSTEM / superuser GUC changes.

expected.description: Connection-time persistence via preload libraries / GUCs

detect.postgresql: SELECT name, setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('shared_preload_libraries','session_preload_libraries','local_preload_libraries') AND setting <> ''

root_causes.name: Routine & trigger inventory drift
root_causes.description: A function/trigger present in the live catalog but absent from the deploy baseline (evades owner checks). Needs dbx_routine_inventory_baseline.
root_causes.resolution: Maintain a routine/trigger inventory baseline; investigate any object not in it.

expected.description: Routine & trigger inventory drift

root_causes.name: High-privilege DEFINER routine in an app schema (MySQL/MariaDB)
root_causes.description: A routine SQL SECURITY DEFINER with DEFINER=root/admin/mysql.sys living in an app schema (T1548). MySQL/MariaDB-specific.
root_causes.resolution: Re-define routines to a least-privilege account; avoid root/admin DEFINER in application schemas.

expected.description: High-privilege DEFINER routine in an app schema (MySQL/MariaDB)

detect.mysql: SELECT routine_schema AS schema_name, routine_name, definer, security_type FROM information_schema.routines WHERE security_type = 'DEFINER' AND definer REGEXP '^(root|admin|mysql.sys)@' AND routine_schema NOT IN ('sys','mysql','performance_schema','information_schema')

root_causes.name: SQL Server startup-procedure persistence
root_causes.description: A procedure flagged via sp_procoption 'startup' auto-runs on every instance restart (T1505.001). SQL Server-specific.
root_causes.resolution: List ExecIsStartup procedures; disable any not sanctioned; restrict sp_procoption.

expected.description: SQL Server startup-procedure persistence

detect.sqlserver: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS procedure_name FROM sys.procedures p JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id = p.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id WHERE OBJECTPROPERTY(p.object_id, 'ExecIsStartUp') = 1

root_causes.name: PostgreSQL command-executing GUC
root_causes.description: A shell payload in archive_command/restore_command/etc. runs as the server OS user (T1059/T1546).
root_causes.resolution: Review archive/recovery command GUCs; remove shell payloads; restrict ALTER SYSTEM.

expected.description: PostgreSQL command-executing GUC

detect.postgresql: SELECT name, setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('archive_command','restore_command','archive_cleanup_command','recovery_end_command','ssl_passphrase_command') AND setting <> ''

root_causes.name: Self-healing event trigger
root_causes.description: An event-trigger function that re-CREATEs the backdoor when dropped — can be deploy-owned (evades owner filters).
root_causes.resolution: Inspect event-trigger function bodies for re-plant DDL; remove the trigger and the object it recreates.

expected.description: Self-healing event trigger

detect.postgresql: SELECT e.evtname AS event_trigger, p.proname AS function FROM pg_event_trigger e JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid = e.evtfoid WHERE p.prosrc ~* 'create\s+(or\s+replace\s+)?(function|trigger|role|extension|event\s+trigger)' ORDER BY e.evtname

root_causes.name: MySQL/MariaDB init_connect / init_file
root_causes.description: SQL auto-run on every connection or at startup via server variables — no schema object (T1546). MySQL/MariaDB-specific.
root_causes.resolution: Review init_connect / init_file values; clear unauthorised payloads; restrict SUPER/SYSTEM_VARIABLES_ADMIN.

expected.description: MySQL/MariaDB init_connect / init_file

detect.mysql: SELECT variable_name, variable_value FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE variable_name IN ('init_connect','init_file') AND variable_value <> ''

root_causes.name: Oracle Scheduler-job persistence / time-bomb
root_causes.description: A dba_scheduler_jobs entry with job_type=EXECUTABLE or dangerous job_action, optionally future-dated (T1053/T1059). Oracle-specific.
root_causes.resolution: Review scheduler jobs for EXECUTABLE/OS actions and future start dates; disable unauthorised jobs.

expected.description: Oracle Scheduler-job persistence / time-bomb

detect.oracle: SELECT owner, job_name, job_type, job_action, TO_CHAR(start_date) AS start_date FROM dba_scheduler_jobs WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND (job_type = 'EXECUTABLE' OR REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(job_action), 'HOST|DBMS_SCHEDULER|EXTERNAL'))

root_causes.name: Outbound foreign server / data wrapper
root_causes.description: A foreign-data-wrapper server + user mapping (and foreign tables) to an off-allow-list endpoint — standing egress (T1041).
root_causes.resolution: Inventory foreign tables and their servers; confirm endpoints; drop unsanctioned foreign tables.

expected.description: Outbound foreign server / data wrapper

detect.postgresql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, c.relname AS foreign_table, s.srvname AS foreign_server FROM pg_foreign_table ft JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = ft.ftrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_foreign_server s ON s.oid = ft.ftserver ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname

root_causes.name: SQL Server Agent CmdExec / PowerShell job
root_causes.description: An Agent job step using CmdExec/PowerShell/ActiveScripting/SSIS runs OS commands on a schedule without xp_cmdshell (T1053.005/T1059). SQL Server-specific.
root_causes.resolution: Review SQL Server Agent job steps for CmdExec/PowerShell subsystems; remove unauthorised jobs.

expected.description: SQL Server Agent CmdExec / PowerShell job

detect.sqlserver: SELECT j.name AS job_name, st.step_name, st.subsystem, st.command FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps st ON st.job_id = j.job_id WHERE st.subsystem IN ('CmdExec','PowerShell','ActiveScripting','SSIS')
